decks.name: LeetCode #66 - Plus One
decks.description: Increment a large integer represented as an array of digits by one

cards.question: Plus One: You are given a large integer represented as an integer array digits, where each digits[i] is the ith digit of the integer. The digits are ordered from most significant to least significant in left-to-right order. The large integer does not contain any leading zeros. Increment the large integer by one and return the resulting array of digits.

solutions.name: Iteration - II
solutions.explanation: Iterate backwards through the digits. If a digit is less than 9, increment it and return immediately. If it is 9, set it to 0 and continue to the next digit. If all digits are 9, prepend 1 to the array of zeros. Most elegant solution with minimal operations.

solutions.name: Recursion
solutions.explanation: Base case: empty array returns [1]. If last digit is less than 9, increment and return. Otherwise, recursively call on all digits except the last, then append 0. Uses array slicing which creates new arrays at each recursive level.
